entries.back_en: Ah, Princess Elina! And Princess [04]! They are both so beautiful! What would I do if both confessed their love for me? How could I choose between them!?
I'm sorry, but ordinary citizens... ...Princess [04]!?
entries.note: Expanded 'ordinary' to 'ordinary citizens', consistent with next line.

entries.back_en: Ordinary citizens cannot... Huh? Princess [04]!
Does this mean Princess Elina isn't coming back?
What was I supposed to think? My daughter goes out in search of her missing sister, only to be caught trespassing in enemy territory... How did this happen?
So, what do you intend to do now? Sooner or later, the Ludians are bound to discover you are here. We will of course do everything we can to protect you...
entries.note: 'Faremos claro que podemos fazer tudo para protege-lo' is garbled; should be 'faremos tudo o que pudermos'.

entries.back_en: The King has been put in a very difficult position... On one hand he must protect his daughter, Princess [04], and on the other maintain our relations with Ludia.
I pity the poor King... Although he worries about Princess Elina more than anyone, he does not discuss the matter with anyone in public. It breaks my heart to see him...
We've received reports that Ludian troops were spotted near the castle. You must hurry, before they find out you are here!
Princess Elina is betrothed to marry the Prince of Ludia... Princess [04] is next in line to the throne... Which should I choose-- a love that is wrong, or a love that cannot be?
entries.note: 'noiva para casar' slightly awkward but meaning intact.

entries.back_en: Wait... If Princess [04] and I are joined together, that means one day I'll be King of Wyndia... Will I be able to handle the responsibility?
If I marry Princess Elina, that means the whole country of Ludia will be out to get us... Will I be able to protect her from them?
Hmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? Now I understand why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best of luck.
Hmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? Now I understand why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best of luck.
[04]... There is little I can do now. You have grown much, my daughter. You are strong enough to fight your own battles now. I am very proud of you!
If I marry Princess [04], all of this... the town, the people... All of it will be mine! Ha ha... Bwah ha ha ha ha!
You went to the Tower of Wind? What did you think? Pretty tall, isn't it? I wish I could've gone with you...
Why, Princess [04]! For a moment I almost mistook you for your sister. You've grown much more like her recently -- more confident, more mature. If only she were here to see you now!
Ha ha... Bwah ha ha ha! Look at the folks down there! They look like ants! Insects! Bwah ha ha ha ha!
The power we need to operate this lift comes from all the windmills.
Welcome home, Princess [04]!
entries.note: 'Bem-vinda em casa' slightly off; 'de volta'/'ao lar' preferable but understandable.

entries.back_en: Everyone has been worried about you.
Strategy sessions were held every day here during the war. I'm glad the war is over! I hope we never have another!
P'ung Ryong, the Wind Dragon, is unusual among his kind in that he still interacts with mortals and speaks to them from time to time.
entries.note: 'incomum entre seus pares em que ainda interage' is awkward; better 'por ainda interagir'.

entries.back_en: I pay little attention to what goes on outside the castle, but even I can see the world is changing...
We caught someone trying to sneak into the castle. I'd be careful if I were you!
entries.note: 'keep my distance' rendered as 'be careful'; minor nuance shift, acceptable.
